privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.pending: The full privacy policy is being written and will replace this page before launch. Until then, this is a short summary of what already holds.

points.security: Where documents are stored, how long they are kept and who processes them is described in the <terms>Terms</terms>, including the <subprocessors>list of subprocessors</subprocessors>.
points.contact: Contact requests sent through this site are emailed to us and not stored on the site.
points.analytics: Google Analytics only runs on the public website, and only after you accept statistics cookies. The app under /app never loads it. You can change your choice under Cookie settings.
points.cookies: Two functional cookies need no consent: one remembers your language, one remembers your cookie choice.
